headings.guidelines: Use tracking-tight for sizes above 32px. Elegant, trustworthy look.

body.guidelines: Clean, highly readable, standard sans-serif for content.

typography.hierarchy_rules: Do not exceed text-5xl or text-6xl for hero headings. Subheadings should be no more than 2 steps down from headings.

colors.primary_description: Navy Blue - Use for main nav, footer, primary buttons, and hero overlay (mixed with black or dark gradient).
colors.secondary_description: Maroon - Use for secondary accents, hover states, or important callouts.
colors.accent_description: Gold Accent - Use for highlights, active links, subtle borders, and key icons.
colors.background_description: Light Cream - Use as the main background for the site to provide a warm, trustworthy feel instead of stark white.
colors.surface_description: White - Use for cards, dropdowns, and elevated surfaces to contrast with Light Cream.

visual_enhancers.shadows: Subtle, soft shadows for modern cards (e.g., shadow-[0_8px_30px_rgb(11,37,69,0.06)]).
visual_enhancers.borders: 1px solid #E5E7EB or #B8923D/20 on cards and sections.
visual_enhancers.border_radius: Rounded cards, standard rounded-xl or rounded-2xl.
visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Use for the sticky navigation bar (backdrop-blur-md bg-white/80) to ensure content scrolls cleanly underneath.
visual_enhancers.hover_effects: Cards lift slightly (-translate-y-1) with an intensified shadow. Buttons should have color shifts (e.g., Primary to Secondary) and scale slightly.

layouts.hero: Full height or min-h-[80vh] with the primary school exterior image. Gradient overlay (bg-gradient-to-r from-[#0B2545]/80 to-transparent) to ensure Lora headings and Inter text are perfectly readable. Left-aligned content.
layouts.about: Asymmetrical 2-column layout. Image on one side (with soft rounded corners and drop shadow), text on the other.
layouts.why_choose_us: Bento grid or 3-column masonry/grid of rounded cards. Icons with Gold accent.
layouts.facilities: Grid of image cards with overlay text. Or alternating row layout.
layouts.gallery: Masonry grid or tight 4-6 image grid with hover zoom (scale-105) inside overflow-hidden wrappers.
layouts.contact: 2-column layout. Left side: Contact info and map placeholder. Right side: Front-end inquiry form.
layouts.spacing: Generous spacing. Use py-16 or py-24 for section paddings. Grid gaps of gap-8 or gap-12.

motion.scroll_animations: Use framer-motion. Fade in and translate up (y: 20 -> 0) for sections as they enter viewport.
motion.micro_interactions: Hover states on all buttons, links, and cards. Use smooth transitions (duration-300 ease-out).

components.navigation: Sticky top, z-50. Glassmorphism effect. Contains Logo/Name, Links (Home, About Us, Academics, Admissions, Gallery, Contact), and Apply Now button.
components.cards: White background, rounded-2xl, subtle shadow, p-6 or p-8.
components.buttons: Pill-shaped (rounded-full) or slightly rounded (rounded-lg). Primary button: Navy background, White text. Secondary/Hover: Maroon or Gold.
components.footer: Navy Blue background, White/Light Cream text. 4-column layout (About, Quick Links, Contact, Social). Large bottom padding.
components.back_to_top: Fixed bottom right, Gold accent or Navy, appears after scrolling.
components.faq: Shadcn Accordion. Clean lines, plus/minus icons.

instructions_to_main_agent: Build a multi-page routing structure using React Router (Home, About, Academics, Admissions, Gallery, Contact).
Implement the sticky navigation bar with a backdrop-blur-md on scroll.
Use Framer Motion for smooth scroll animations (fade-in, slide-up) for sections.
Apply Lora font to all headings (h1 to h6) and Inter to body text.

Follow the color palette strictly: Navy Blue (#0B2545) for main structural elements, Maroon (#7A1F3D) and Gold (#B8923D) for accents and buttons, Light Cream (#FAF6EE) for the page background, White (#FFFFFF) for cards.
Create a clean, frontend-only contact form with validation.
Ensure the hero image uses a gradient overlay to maintain accessible contrast for text.
Include a 'Back to Top' button that appears on scroll.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur) for sticky headers.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: transition: all. This results in breaking transforms. Always add transitions for specific interactive elements like button, input excluding transforms.
You MUST NOT center align the app container, ie do not add .App { text-align: center; } in the css file.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui when applicable.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 for icons.
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute to facilitate robust automated testing.
